request.description:
`status`'s request: what the session holds, answered at once, even while another of its
commands runs. It never reads the file.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: StatusRequest

base.description: The revision the transaction began from: the one `rollback` returns to.

revision.description: The revision it's of: the session's current one.

RebuildState.description: What's become of a revision's rebuild.

oneOf.description:
Not started: no command has needed its model yet, or the gate refused the document,
so there's nothing to rebuild.

Done, but its model holds a kernel fault, kept as the revision's outcome (reads give
it once, in the response's `model.fault`); or its recompute failed.
Cancelled: the next command that needs its model starts it again.

SessionCommand.description: A command that runs in a session, by name, as a tool is named: what `status` says is running, and `cancel` stops.

result.description:
`status`'s result. What's running is a diagnostic, not a result: it depends on when it's
asked.

features.description: How many features the document has: null if its text doesn't read as a document.

gated.description: Whether the gate took the document.

reads.description:
Each read of the published model running, in the order they started: `cancel` stops
every one of a name.

running.description: The session's queued command running, which `cancel` can stop: null if none is.

transaction.description: The transaction open, as `begin` answered it: null if none is.

result.title: StatusResult
